Clay used to live primarily in the Clay UI. Now Clay also works where your agents, developers, and business systems already are. Use the developer platform to search Clay’s GTM data, run reusable Clay logic, read table data, and work with Audiences programmatically.

## Start here

## Install the Clay plugin

Best for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and agent-first work. The plugin ships skills and the Clay CLI.

## Call the API directly

Best for backend jobs, internal tools, custom apps, queues, and product workflows.

## Core primitives

| Primitive | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [Searches](/searches) | Find companies and people using Clay’s GTM database |
| [Routines](/routines) | Run Clay-managed functions, custom functions, and Workflows |
| [Tables (Enterprise)](/tables) | Query existing Clay table data from known tables |
| [Audiences](/audiences) | Work with records, saved segments, activities, and signal events |
| [Signals](/signals) | Create triggers that detect relevant changes across records |

Start with the primitive that matches where your data lives and what you want to do.

## Choose the right primitive

- Need a target list? Use [Searches](/searches).
- Need enrichment, scoring, routing, or reusable logic? Use [Routines](/routines).
- Need existing table data? Use [Tables](/tables). Tables are Enterprise only.
- Need Audiences records, saved segments, activities, or signal events? Use [Audiences](/audiences).
- Need triggers that watch records and produce signal events? Use [Signals](/signals).

## Analyze recent closed-won deals

Use an agent to find patterns in recent successful deals.
